$comment: Demo collections offered on /try. Add a dataset by copying its zip into this directory (keep it under ~20 MB — Cloudflare rejects static assets over 25 MiB) and appending an entry here. `path` may also be an absolute URL to a CORS-open host for larger archives. No app code needs to change.

collections.name: 100 works with full catalogue metadata
collections.note: Ships a metadata.csv, so the suggested searches come from real artists, media and classifications rather than filenames.

collections.name: 45 works, Met open access
collections.note: A second institution, to show the pipeline is not tuned to one collection.

collections.name: 30 works, Cleveland open access
collections.note: Smallest set — quickest end-to-end run if you are in a hurry.

collections.name: 25 works, no metadata
collections.note: Titles come from filenames — proof that a plain folder of images is enough.
